download.verification: SHA256 computed over complete downloaded archive; verified HTTP range sizes and Content-Range during retrieval

official_source.file_manifest: Retained with the external source reference; intentionally not committed.
official_source.archive_scope: Kernel and additional Android external/vendor source; only Code_Opensource/kernel extracted in full.
official_source.license: COPYING states GPL version 2 unless explicitly otherwise stated; preserve individual file license notices.
official_source.match_limitation: Official package is BLA-AL00B EMUI10, not source explicitly matched to BLA-L29 EMUI12 .225. Requires live config, DT, firmware interface and boot validation.

development_base.recommendation: Retain the existing hisi-oss-derived fork for development, preserve the verified official BLA10 source as a separate reference outside Git, and compare device-critical differences before hardware tests.

comparison.scope: Selected kernel build, config, partition and Kirin970 platform files; not a complete source audit.
comparison.evidence_retention: Detailed per-file hashes and diffs retained with the separately downloaded official source, outside this repository.
comparison.config_limitation: Official defconfig is a full configuration; development defconfig is compact. Omitted declarations cannot be treated as disabled features without Kconfig resolution.
